items.name: Roadwarden's Bracer
items.lore: The Watch gives one to anyone who keeps the Connacht road open.

items.name: Bocan-Tooth Charm
items.lore: A bocan's tooth on a cord. It still tries to bite.

items.name: Fog-Lantern Ring
items.lore: A ring with a chip of lantern-glass. It glows faintly in fog.

items.name: Field-Warden's Belt
items.lore: Plain leather, with a bone whistle for calling the watch.

items.name: Salvaged Axe-Head Charm
items.lore: A Norse axe-head, found in a Hibernian fishing hut.

items.name: Fisher's Oilskin Cloak
items.lore: Stiff with salt. It has kept a lot of rain off a lot of fishermen.

items.name: Watchtower Torc
items.lore: Bronze, with the watchtower worked into the clasp.

items.name: Beacon-Keeper Bracer
items.lore: Scorched round the cuff by a hundred lightings of the beacon.

items.name: Fetch-Glass Pendant
items.lore: A little mirror that shows you a moment late. You get used to it.

items.name: Sorcha's Comb-Pin
items.lore: A comb of white bone. The fetch carried it; it is the only thing of hers it took.

items.name: Bocan-Hide Bracer
items.lore: The bocan are goblins of the cliffs. This one's hide is tough as boot-leather.

items.name: Cliff-Walker's Cloak
items.lore: Grey wool, weighted at the hem against the cliff wind.

items.name: Seer's Mirror Ring
items.lore: A ring set with a tiny mirror. Seers use them to catch fetches looking.

items.name: Omen-Knot Belt
items.lore: Knotted with the seven omens. You can untie one, once.

items.name: Cairn-Stone Charm
items.lore: A pebble from the Grey Man's cairn. It is always damp.

items.name: Fetch-Follower's Bracer
items.lore: Soft leather, for walking quietly behind things that shouldn't know you're there.

items.name: Grey Man's Fleece Mantle
items.lore: Woven from the grey fleece, cleansed by the Seers. It still smells faintly of roses.

items.name: Fear Liath Ward
items.lore: A Seers' ward against the Grey Man. It works on fog, mostly.

items.name: Seventh-Omen Ring
items.lore: The seventh omen is 'the one you didn't see coming'. This ring is for that one.

items.name: Net-Mender's Ring
items.lore: Nuala's spare. She mends nets with it on.

items.name: Tide-Pool Charm
items.lore: A shell from the tide pools. Put it to your ear and the sea says your name.

items.name: Koalinth-Scale Token
items.lore: A blue-green scale, pierced and hung on a cord. The koalinth give them to children they claim.

items.name: Pact-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Cut from the koalinth tide-caller's own hand.

items.name: Tide-Caller Mantle
items.lore: Woven of kelp and something finer. Water runs off it like off a seal.

items.name: Spearman's Bracer
items.lore: Cliff-dweller work, bone and sinew.

items.name: Sea-Stack Bracer
items.lore: Barnacled stone, ground smooth. Waves have been trying to break it for a thousand years.

items.name: Pilot's Knot Charm
items.lore: A sea-knot in tarred rope. It shows the way through rocks, if you can read it.

items.name: Brarn's Shell Crown
items.lore: Brarn's crown of shells. It hums with the tide.

items.name: Koalinth Chief-Ring
items.lore: A heavy ring of sea-gold.

items.name: Rock-Road Cloak
items.lore: Sealskin, grey-green. It's never quite dry.

items.name: Cliff-Top Bracer
items.lore: Cliff dweller work: bone and hide, stitched with gut.

items.name: Watchman's Whistle Charm
items.lore: A bone whistle. Every watchman on the cliffs carries one.

items.name: Lookout's Ring
items.lore: A ring with a notch for sighting along. Cliff dweller lookouts use them.

items.name: Raven-Coin Belt
items.lore: A belt hung with Norse coins, taken from cliff dweller purses.

items.name: Spear-Breaker's Bracer
items.lore: Bound tight round the forearm, for catching spear-shafts.

items.name: Nets-of-the-Cliff Charm
items.lore: A knot from a cliff dweller's net, the kind they use to drop on you from above.

items.name: Whelihan's Chief-Torc
items.lore: The torc of the cliff dwellers' chief. It's heavier than it looks.

items.name: Cliff-Hold Mantle
items.lore: Hides stitched together the way the cliff dwellers do it. Warm as a house.

items.name: Sold-Word Ring
items.lore: A ring with a raven on it, from a chief who sold his word.

items.name: Stockade-Scout's Ring
items.lore: A ring with a notch for every stake counted.

items.name: Raven-Rune Charm
items.lore: A raven rune, cut from a Norse shield.

items.name: Thrall-Chain Bracer
items.lore: A link of thrall-chain, broken and beaten into a bracer.

items.name: Freed Man's Belt
items.lore: Breasal the fisher's own belt. He gave it to you when you cut his chain.

items.name: Skald's Harp-Peg Charm
items.lore: A harp peg of walrus ivory. It remembers every saga it ever held tight.

items.name: Saga-Teller's Ring
items.lore: A Norse ring, engraved with the first line of a saga that hasn't finished yet.

items.name: Raven-Banner Cloak
items.lore: Cut from the longphort's banner. The raven looks the other way now.

items.name: Jarl's Arm-Ring
items.lore: Thick gold, taken from Jarl Hrafn's own high seat.

items.name: Longphort-Breaker Torc
items.lore: Iron and bronze, given to whoever broke into the longphort first.

items.name: Rift-Shard Charm
items.lore: A shard of solid air from the distorters' rift. It's lighter than nothing.

items.name: Distorter-Hide Bracer
items.lore: It bends the light a little around your wrist.

items.name: Aoife's Thorn Ring
items.lore: A ring of twisted thorn, cold as frost. Aoife's.

items.name: Court-Silk Belt
items.lore: Grey-green silk, finer than any weaver in Hibernia could make.

items.name: Hissing-Stone Torc
items.lore: A sliver of the circle's stone, quiet again.

items.name: Circle-Warden's Bracer
items.lore: Granite-grey, cut with the circle's ogham.

items.name: Fear Liath's Grey Mantle
items.lore: The Grey Man's own mantle of fog, caught and woven. It's lighter than it should be.

items.name: Clear-Weather Ring
items.lore: Since you wore it, it hasn't rained on you once.

items.name: Wrecker-Bane Torc
items.lore: Given to whoever ended the wrecking of the Cliffs of Moher.

items.name: Thorn-Crown Charm
items.lore: A chip of the fog-stone's thorn crown, cleansed. It still points east.
